meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline_en: Route NanoClaw agent group to local Ollama model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run AI agents locally and cut API costs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能按你的要求把指定 NanoClaw 代理组改为使用本地 Ollama 模型，它负责修改相关配置、设置模型名并重启服务，之后该代理组不再走 Anthropic API，而是调用本地模型。
howto.when: 当你希望代理组在本地运行、节省 API 费用或尝试开源模型时，提出需求并指定代理组和模型名，就会触发。

say.text: 帮我把代理组 A 切换到 Ollama 模型 B
say.note: Claude 会询问具体名称并修改配置重启。

say.text: 用本地 Ollama 运行代理组 A，并屏蔽 Anthropic API
say.note: Claude 会添加屏蔽配置，防止意外用 API。

say.text: 把代理组 A 切回 Anthropic API
say.note: Claude 会移除相关配置并重启服务。

howto.what_en: With this skill installed, Claude can switch a chosen NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model on request. It updates the container config, sets the model name, and restarts the service, so the group no longer uses the Anthropic API but the local model.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you want to run an agent locally, save API costs, or try open-weight models, and you name the agent group and model.

say_en.text: Switch agent group A to Ollama model B
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details and update config.

say_en.text: Run agent group A with local Ollama and block Anthropic API
say_en.note: Claude will add block settings and restart.

say_en.text: Switch agent group A back to Anthropic API
say_en.note: Claude will remove overrides and restart.
